snippet.title: Last Buzz – Official Early Access Trailer | Your Friends Are the Flies
snippet.description:
One of your friends is crawling across the kitchen ceiling. Another is stuck under a glass jar. You’ve almost caught the last fly when you hear a horn behind you. Who’s watching the jar?

Last Buzz is out now in Steam Early Access. Play on PC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4927030/Last_Buzz/

Grab 2–9 players for a game of humans vs. flies. As a hunter, set traps and catch your friends in jars. As a fly, sneak through vents, crawl on walls, and free your teammates. Voice chat comes in handy when the friend you just hit with a snowball is the only one who can rescue you.

Play Hide & Seek with three hearts per fly, or try Survival, where hunger eventually forces you out of your favorite hiding spot. Early Access brings a winter version of the house, throwable snowballs, and magic mushrooms. Eat the right one and you can fly straight through a wall.

Made by the two of us at FewCoolGames. We launched on November 17, 2026. Thanks to everyone who played the demo and helped us get here!

#LastBuzz #MultiplayerGames #IndieGame
